```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(tidymodels)
library(gbm)
library(e1071)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)
library(pdp)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)
library(corrplot)
```
# Load the data
```{r}
load("severity.RData")
dat <- na.omit(dat)
set.seed(4027)
my_dat <- dat[sample(nrow(dat), 1000), ]
```

# Convert Variables
```{r}
my_dat <- my_dat %>%
  mutate(
    severity = factor(severity,
                      levels = c(0,1),
                      labels = c("NotSevere","Severe")),

    gender = factor(gender,
                    levels = c(0,1),
                    labels = c("Female","Male")),

    hypertension = factor(hypertension,
                    levels = c(0,1),
                    labels = c("No","Yes")),
    diabetes = factor(diabetes,
               levels = c(0,1),
               labels = c("No","Yes")),
    vaccine = factor(vaccine,
              levels = c(0,1),
              labels = c("Not vaccinated","Vaccinated")),

    race = factor(race,
                  levels = c(1,2,3,4),
                  labels = c("White","Asian","Black","Hispanic")),

    smoking = factor(smoking,
                     levels = c(0,1,2),
                     labels = c("Never","Former","Current"))
  )
```

# Train test split
```{r}
set.seed(1234)
split <- initial_split(my_dat,
                       prop = 0.8,
                       strata = severity)

train_dat <- training(split)
test_dat  <- testing(split)
```

# Exploratory Analysis
```{r}
# Summary table
summary_table <- train_dat %>%
  select(-id) %>%
  summary()
knitr::kable(summary_table)
```

```{r}
# Continuous variable
p1 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = age,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Age by Severity")

p2 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = height,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Height by Severity")

p3 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = weight,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Weight by Severity")

p4 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = bmi,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("BMI by Severity")

p5 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = SBP,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("SBP by Severity")

p6 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = LDL,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("LDL by Severity")

p7 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = depression,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Depression by Severity")

((p1 + p2 + p3) /
 (p4 + p5 + p6) /
 (p7)) +
plot_layout(guides = "collect",
            heights = c(1,1,1.5)) &
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
)

```

```{r}
# Correlations
continuous_vars <- my_dat %>%
  select(
    age,
    height,
    weight,
    bmi,
    SBP,
    LDL,
    depression
  )

cor_matrix <- cor(continuous_vars)

corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.7
)
```


# Logistic Regression
```{r}
logit_fit <- glm(
  severity ~ age + gender + race + smoking +
    bmi + hypertension + diabetes +
    SBP + LDL + vaccine + depression,
  data = train_dat,
  family = binomial
)

summary(logit_fit)
```
